name: planning-center-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Planning Center Online TypeScript API client libraries

scripts.docs:build:packages: (cd packages/planning-center-base-ts && npm run build) && (cd packages/planning-center-people-ts && npm run build) && (cd packages/planning-center-check-ins-ts && npm run build)
scripts.publish:prep:full: npm run docs:build:packages && (cd packages/planning-center-base-ts && npm test) && (cd packages/planning-center-people-ts && npm run test:ci) && (cd packages/planning-center-check-ins-ts && npm run test:ci)
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run publish:prep && (cd packages/planning-center-base-ts && npm publish --dry-run) && (cd packages/planning-center-people-ts && npm publish --dry-run) && (cd packages/planning-center-check-ins-ts && npm publish --dry-run)
